GadScape build 241 TEST client: what is in this package and under which terms
==============================================================================

The GadScape launcher (lib/gadscape-launcher.jar) is GadScape's own code. Everything else is RuneLite 1.13.3
and the libraries RuneLite ships with, redistributed unchanged except the game client (see the first row).
The license texts are in this folder; the file name is given after each entry.

lib/injected-client-1.13.3-gadscape.jar
    RuneLite's injected-client 1.13.3: the Old School RuneScape game client (build 241), copyright Jagex Ltd.,
    with RuneLite's injected code. Not open source. Changed by GadScape's patcher in two places (the login RSA
    key and the server-address check) so it can connect to the GadScape TEST server. For testing only;
    not affiliated with or endorsed by Jagex or RuneLite.

RuneLite, BSD 2-Clause, Copyright (c) 2016-2017, Adam <Adam@sigterm.info>      RuneLite-BSD-2-Clause.txt
    client-1.13.3.jar, runelite-api-1.13.3-runtime.jar, http-api-1.2.26.jar      https://github.com/runelite/runelite
    rlicn-1.1-windows.jar (RuneLite's Windows icon helper; no license file in the jar, published by RuneLite)
rlawt-1.8.jar, BSD 2-Clause, Copyright (c) 2022 Abex                            rlawt-BSD-2-Clause.txt
    https://github.com/runelite/rlawt
discord-1.4.jar, RuneLite's build of Java Discord RPC, Apache 2.0,              java-discord-rpc-Apache-2.0.txt
    Copyright (c) 2017 Florian Spiess; https://github.com/runelite/java-discord-rpc
    It contains Discord RPC (libdiscord-rpc), MIT, Copyright 2017 Discord, Inc.  discord-rpc-MIT.txt
flatlaf-3.2.5-rl4.jar, FlatLaf (RuneLite build), Apache 2.0, FormDev Software   Apache-2.0.txt
    https://github.com/JFormDesigner/FlatLaf
LWJGL 3.3.2, BSD 3-Clause, Copyright (c) 2012-present Lightweight Java Game Library   LWJGL-BSD-3-Clause.txt
    lwjgl-3.3.2.jar, lwjgl-opengl-3.3.2.jar, lwjgl-opencl-3.3.2.jar and their natives-*.jar   https://www.lwjgl.org
Guava 23.2, Apache 2.0, Google                                                  Apache-2.0.txt

Source code of the open-source parts: the project links above (RuneLite's own jars also have -sources jars on
https://repo.runelite.net). The exact jar addresses and SHA-256 hashes are in the GadScape repository,
client241/runelite-1.13.3.lock.
